question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 25 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The increase in request volume and error rate are likely due to the flash sale campaign going live.
why_chain: The flash sale campaign went live at the same time as the change point.
Increased request volume led to higher p95 latency.
Error rate increased due to the higher load on the system.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in latency was due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence supports a configuration change as the cause.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in latency was due to a dependency issue with an external service.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence supports a dependency issue with an external service.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in latency was due to a data quality issue.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence supports a data quality issue.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for region eu-west rose from 137 ms to 219 ms (+60%), with a change point at 2026-03-25T08:10:00Z.
The change is concentrated in region eu-west: 4 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.02).
At the same time, request volume for region eu-west rose (2048 per 5 min before, 9799 per 5 min after, +379%).
At the same time, error rate for region eu-west rose (0.37% before, 0.74% after, +102%).
Marketing: flash sale campaign goes live in eu-west at 08:10 UTC (eu-west; 162 min before the change; record R011)
Request volume 3x normal in eu-west (eu-west; 12 min after the change; record R012)
autoscaler: scaling out, 4 new instances requested (eu-west; 20 min after the change; record R013)

reasons: ✓ A change event (tickets) lines up in time (162 min before the change).
✓ 2 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume rose, as a traffic cause requires.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Implement a traffic management system to handle sudden spikes in traffic during campaigns.
Review and optimize the autoscaler configuration to avoid unnecessary scaling out.
Monitor and adjust the autoscaler to avoid scaling out during sudden traffic spikes.
